role: Extension of RecoveryScoreCalculator computing Foster monotony and strain from daily TRIMP over the trailing 7 calendar days (used by the Load & Trajectory surface and training advice, not the recovery score).

units.does: Builds the 7 start-of-day dates ending at referenceDate (Calendar.current), reads dailyTrimp per date (missing=0), returns (monotony, strain=sum*monotony) or nil when fewer than 7 dates could be built or the week's sum is 0.

branches.effect: day missing from dict counts as 0 load

flags.text: Lookup is by exact Date key equal to Calendar.current.startOfDay; any dailyTrimp key not normalised to local start-of-day (or built under a different time zone) silently reads as 0 load.

units.does: Monotony = mean/SD (population SD) of values, capped at Training.monotonyCap; cap also returned when SD==0 or values empty.

branches.effect: false (empty array) returns monotonyCap — unreachable from the only caller, which guarantees 7 values
true: mean/sd; false: monotonyCap; then min(raw, cap)
